d.ko:
Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion adventure game where you work alongside Meru Momozono.
Customize your Pomodoro timer, to-do list, calendar, music, and ambient sounds.
As you spend more time together, your story with Meru gradually unfolds.

d.zh:
《Muv-Luv少女庭园 Mellow Days》是一款专注陪伴冒险游戏，让你与桃园梅露共享一段时光，一起完成每天的任务。
 按照自己的喜好设置番茄钟、ToDo清单、日历、音乐和环境音。随着共同努力的时间不断累积，你与梅露的故事也将逐渐展开。
